title: Payment step 1 — quote 1,000 CLP of output, 15-second TTL (no credentials)
description: An exact-OUTPUT quote: the payer names what the beneficiary must receive and the AMM answers what that costs. 542.75 W-tCeBM_CRC buys exactly 1,000 W-tCeBM_CLP at the current reserves, 30 bps fee included.
notes: Gateway: any. THE QUOTE LIVES 15 SECONDS — created_at 1781776800, valid_until 1781776815 — so quote and swap must be issued programmatically in one step; a test that pauses between them will flake. BLOCKING DIVERGENCE, documented in contracts/amm: the platform document declares ZERO parameters for this operation while the handler requires three (source_currency, target_currency, amount_out); following the document literally always yields 400. Note created_at and valid_until are Unix INTEGERS here, unlike almost every other timestamp in this surface, which are RFC 3339 strings. Undocumented upstream: 422 INSUFFICIENT_POOL_LIQUIDITY. The numbers are reproducible from mock-amm-hp-04: for reserves 500000e18 / 925000e18 and a 30 bps fee, the constant-product exact-output input for 1000e18 out is reserve_a*out*10000 // ((reserve_b-out)*9970) + 1.
